dialogue.text: Whoa, GGma! Run out of ink cartridges or something?
PJ, be careful. She feels... immensely powerful. And so, so sad.
Super... So you've come to gloat? To see the miracle of my unmaking?
Super? The frack you talkin' about? And yeah, what gives? You look like you're leaking.
My state is of no concern to the company you keep.
Yo! That's my girlfriend, not my pet, you washed-up deity!
PJ, it's okay... she's clearly not well.
Not well? I am creation itself! And you... you were my conscience. You dare to judge me now?
Fine. Let's see if your new form still remembers how to sing of miracles.
